_arch_note: exp_n_0083 (untied unembedder) with ONE change: FFN-slot CompressionMHL lut_n_heads 8->4. FFN LUT table params scale with n_heads (tables = n_heads*tph), so halving heads roughly halves the FFN LUT table params. Untied unembedder KEPT (tie_unembedder=false), inner 48, nap=7, tph=256, forward_mode=hard, decompress 48->384, depth 6, n_embd 384, device_batch 24/grad_accum 2. Goal: trade the exp_n_0083 win (~1.189) for a leaner model by halving FFN routing heads. Targets: exp_n_0083 ~1.189 (preserve), exp_n_0045 1.1977 (tied baseline).
_mem_note: device_batch_size 48->24 (grad_accum 1->2) vs exp_n_0045: the untied head materializes the full [tokens,vocab] logits+grad buffer that the tied graph fused away, which OOM'd at bs48 (LUT dense-K [24576,2048,128]~24GB + logits pushed >79GB). Halving the micro-batch keeps effective batch 24,576 identical (grad accumulation is mathematically equivalent) — science unchanged, memory halved.
